techniques.justification: Exploiting the heap buffer overflow in V8 can allow an attacker to manipulate browser sessions and hijack them.
The heap buffer overflow vulnerability can be exploited to execute arbitrary code in the context of the victim's browser session.
By exploiting the vulnerability, an attacker can potentially forge web credentials to gain unauthorized access to web applications or services.
The attacker can exploit the vulnerability to take over the domain controller, effectively circumventing the normal privilege controls.
The attacker establishes a vulnerable Netlogon secure channel connection to exploit the vulnerability over the network.
The vulnerability is in an internet-facing web application/API, allowing an attacker to exploit it to perform an SSRF attack.
If the stolen credentials are used to access an ESXi host, the attacker could potentially execute commands on guest machines hosted within the ESXi virtual environment.
